title: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP
snippet:
For developers building on the WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) — the WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server lets your AI agent and IDE assistant manage and debug your WhatsApp Business integration from one place. It enables an agent to discover the businesses and WhatsApp accounts you administer, onboard and register phone numbers, create and manage message templates, configure webhooks, and send messages — acting as you, on the apps and businesses you administer.

The following table summarizes the server details:
| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Server name | `WhatsApp Business Tools` |
| Transport | Streamable HTTP |
| Endpoint | `https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools` |
| Authentication | Meta developer account sign-in (OAuth) |
| Client ID | Not required. The server recognizes supported clients automatically. |
| Redirect URI | Not required. You don’t create or configure a Meta app for this server. |
| Supported clients | Claude Code, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Codex CLI, Codex app |
| Status | Beta - interface and tool set may change |

The server is rolling out gradually, so it may not be available to your account yet, even after your client connects.
The server acts on your own assets, so before an agent can use most tools you also need:
- **Admin access to a business** you want to manage (the MANAGE role).
- **A WhatsApp-enabled app that you’re an admin of**, connected to that business — an app with the WhatsApp Business Messaging use case (or the WhatsApp product on an older app). You must have admin access on the app, not only on the business.
- **Accepted WhatsApp Business Cloud API Terms of Service** for that business. Messaging and phone-number registration are blocked until an admin accepts them.

## Scopes
The server requests the following permissions during consent:
| Scope | Access |
|---|---|
| `business_management` | Discover and act on the businesses you administer that you selected during consent. |
| `whatsapp_business_management` | Manage WhatsApp Business accounts, phone numbers, message templates, and webhooks. |
| `whatsapp_business_messaging` | Send messages from your registered phone numbers. |
You can review these permissions, and revoke access, on Facebook under **Settings** > **Your Activity** > **Business Integrations**.

title: Announcing WhatsApp Business Tools MCP: Set up and manage WhatsApp business from your AI agent
snippet:
WhatsApp Business Tools MCP changes that. It's an MCP server that connects your Service Provider AI coding agent (Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT) to the WhatsApp Business Platform, directly in your workflow. You describe what you want; your agent handles the accounts, numbers, templates, and API calls.

### Setup through conversation
Ask your agent to set up WhatsApp Business messaging and it walks the whole path: checks your Terms of Service status, creates a WhatsApp Business Account, adds your phone number, verifies it over OTP, and registers it for the Cloud API.
### Faster template iteration
Describe the message template you want and your agent creates it, or edits an existing one, and links you to its approval progress.

You sign in with Facebook Login for Business and grant a specific set of scopes, so no tokens land in your prompt history. Before any tool runs, the server confirms you're an admin of the app, resolves the attached business, and verifies your Terms of Service are signed. Every read runs under your own viewer context, every invocation is logged, and anything that changes state requires an authenticated person rather than an app-level credential.
## Which Meta MCP server should you use?
Use **Meta Social Technologies MCP** to discover Graph API endpoints, troubleshoot errors, and search documentation. Use **WhatsApp Business Tools MCP** for WhatsApp accounts, phone numbers, templates, webhooks, and test messages. They're complementary; install both if you need both.
**Note:** Meta Business Messaging MCP is rolling out gradually and may not be available to everyone yet.
## Get started
Add the server to your agent's MCP configuration, sign in when prompted, and ask your agent to set up WhatsApp Business messaging. Full setup guide and tool reference can be found [here](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/mcp/whatsapp-business-tools-mcp).
This MCP is currently discoverable on Claude, Codex and ChatGPT.

title: Meta now lets AI agents handle the boring parts of WhatsApp Business setup
snippet:
Alongside news of its new [AI-focused subscription plans](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/15/meta-expands-subscription-push-with-new-ai-focused-plans/), Meta [announced](https://developers.facebook.com/blog/post/2026/09/15/whatsapp-business-messaging-mcp-ai-agent/) on Tuesday that it will now allow AI agents of your choosing to set up and manage [WhatsApp Business](https://whatsappbusiness.com/) messaging, the service that allows companies to connect with customers through WhatsApp conversations.

This is made possible by the new WhatsApp Business Tools MCP, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that directly connects an AI coding agent like Claude, Cursor, Codex, or ChatGPT to the WhatsApp Business Platform.
The move sees Meta expanding its existing lineup of MCP servers beyond [those](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/mcp/devtools-mcp) for managing ads and monitoring app configurations, and other social technologies to one specifically designed to help onboard businesses to WhatsApp. Many other tech companies also offer MCP servers that allow AI agents to securely interact with their services, including PayPal, Stripe, GitHub, Notion, Slack, Salesforce, Atlassian, [X](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/30/x-now-offers-an-mcp-server-to-make-its-platform-easier-for-ai-tools-to-use/), [Google](https://techcrunch.com/2025/12/10/google-is-going-all-in-on-mcp-servers-agent-ready-by-design/), [Microsoft](https://developer.microsoft.com/blog/10-microsoft-mcp-servers-to-accelerate-your-development-workflow/), and others.
In Meta’s case, the AI agent will handle much of the busywork involved in the WhatsApp Business setup process, like creating the company’s WhatsApp Business account, adding and verifying its phone number, registering it for access to the Cloud API, checking the business’ Terms of Service, and more.

During setup and configuration, Meta’s other MCP server, Meta Social Technologies MCP, can also be used to discover API endpoints, search documentation, and help troubleshoot errors, the company noted.

title: GitHub - wassengerhq/whatsapp-mcp: WhatsApp MCP server for the official WhatsApp Business API: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. Hosted by Wassenger.
snippet:
A hosted [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server that lets Claude, Cursor, VS Code, the OpenAI API and any other MCP client work with WhatsApp through the **official WhatsApp Business API**: send and read messages, reply with approved templates, run campaigns, manage contacts and run a shared team inbox.
It is run by [Wassenger](https://wassenger.com). There is nothing to install: point your client at `https://api.wassenger.com/mcp` and send your Wassenger API key in the `Authorization` header. Claude and ChatGPT on the web have no field for a header, so there the key goes in the address instead.
```
Remote URL:  https://api.wassenger.com/mcp
Transport:   Streamable HTTP
Auth:        Authorization: Bearer <WASSENGER_API_KEY>
or https://api.wassenger.com/mcp?key=<WASSENGER_API_KEY> for clients without headers
```
## Business API or personal account?
There are two kinds of WhatsApp MCP servers, and they solve different problems.
| | This server (Wassenger) | Personal-account servers such as [lharries/whatsapp-mcp](https://github.com/lharries/whatsapp-mcp) |
|---|---|---|
| How it connects | Official WhatsApp Business API (Meta Cloud API) | Links your personal account as a WhatsApp Web device |
| Setup | Hosted. Add a URL and an API key | Run a Go bridge and a Python server locally, then scan a QR code |
| Messages outside the 24-hour window | Yes, with approved templates | No templates |
| Several people on one number | Shared inbox, chat assignment, departments, labels | One user |
| Campaigns and bulk sends | Yes, paced by a delivery queue | No |
| Where messages are stored | Your Wassenger account | A SQLite database on your computer |
| WhatsApp's terms | Uses the API Meta provides for businesses | WhatsApp's [Terms of Service](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service) don't allow unofficial clients, so the number can be restricted |
| Cost | Wassenger subscription; Meta bills template messages directly | Free and open source |
If you only want Claude to read and search your own personal chats, a personal-account server is the simpler choice. If WhatsApp is how your business talks to customers, use the Business API.

title: WhatsApp MCP server review: official URL and setup for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
snippet:
# WhatsApp MCP server
Yes. WhatsApp publishes an official MCP server at https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools. It's hosted and lets you sign in with your WhatsApp account. It offers 18 tools. We last checked it on 12 Nov 2026.
Official: documented on WhatsApp's own site, at developers.facebook.com. Checked 12 Nov 2026. Maintained by [Stuart Brameld](https://martechdb.com/methodology#who).
## WhatsApp MCP server review
85/100
WhatsApp's WhatsApp Business MCP server scores 85/100 on MartechDB's Agent Readiness Index: one of the easiest marketing tools to connect an AI agent to. That ranks it joint 9th of 21 in SMS, WhatsApp & push.

Yes. WhatsApp publishes its MCP server itself. WhatsApp's own documentation describes it. MartechDB only lists servers a vendor publishes, never community copies.
### What is the WhatsApp MCP server URL?
The address is https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools.

In Claude, add https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools as a custom connector (Customize, Connectors, Add custom connector). In ChatGPT, turn on developer mode (Settings, Apps, Advanced settings) and create an app with the same address. In Cursor, use the Add to Cursor link on MartechDB's page, or paste the JSON settings into your mcp.json. In Claude Code, run: claude mcp add --transport http whatsapp https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools
### What can the WhatsApp MCP server do?
It offers 18 tools, including whatsapp_biz_businesses, whatsapp_biz_accounts, whatsapp_biz_phone_numbers, whatsapp_biz_add_phone_number and whatsapp_biz_send_verification_code (as its documentation names them, read on 3 Oct 2026).

title: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP Server: Tools, Setup and Security
snippet:
Meta's WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server lets an AI agent set up and manage a WhatsApp Business account. It can add and verify phone numbers, create and edit message templates, configure webhooks and send messages. Meta publishes and hosts it. As of October 2026 it is in beta and rolling out gradually.

- The server URL is `https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools`, over Streamable HTTP.
- Meta labels it "Beta - interface and tool set may change," and says it may not be available to everyone yet.
- You sign in with your Meta developer account and pick which businesses and WhatsApp-enabled apps the server can reach.
- `whatsapp_biz_send_message` is the only sending tool. Meta says it "Confirms the target with you before sending."

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Publisher | Meta |
| Official? | Yes |
| Hosting | Remote URL: `https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools` |
| Transport | Streamable HTTP |
| Sign-in | OAuth with your Meta developer account |
| Read or write | Both |
| Price | No separate MCP price listed |
| Source code | Closed (hosted by Meta) |
| Status | Beta |
## What it can do
Meta's documentation lists these tools by group:
- **Discovery:** `whatsapp_biz_businesses`, `whatsapp_biz_accounts`, `whatsapp_biz_phone_numbers`.
- **Phone onboarding:** `whatsapp_biz_add_phone_number`, `whatsapp_biz_send_verification_code`, `whatsapp_biz_verify_phone_number`, `whatsapp_biz_register_phone_number`.
- **Templates:** `whatsapp_biz_list_templates`, `whatsapp_biz_get_template`, `whatsapp_biz_create_template`, `whatsapp_biz_update_template`, `whatsapp_biz_delete_template`.
- **Messaging:** `whatsapp_biz_send_message`.
- **Webhooks:** `whatsapp_biz_configure_webhooks`, `whatsapp_biz_subscribe_webhook`.
- **Account setup:** `whatsapp_biz_configure_payments`, `whatsapp_biz_verify_business`, `whatsapp_biz_system_user_token`.

Meta's docs give these setups:
**Claude Code:**
```bash
claude mcp add --transport http whatsapp_business_tools https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools
```
Then run `/mcp` and select whatsapp_business_tools to authenticate.
**Claude Desktop:** Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector. Name it WhatsApp Business Tools and enter the server URL.
**Codex App:** Settings > MCP Servers > Add servers. Choose Streamable HTTP, enter the name and URL, set Authentication to OAuth and click Authenticate.
